reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) from PMC11426066 directly demonstrates that adding 50 at.% Pt to FeCoNiMnCu thin films and applying RTA yields a single L1₀ phase with high magnetic anisotropy and a three-order-of-magnitude coercivity increase, supporting all key premises. However, the hypothesis proposes a base FeCoNi system without Mn and Cu, and the cited study uses FeCoNiMnCu, so the exact compositional boundary is slightly overstated.
premises: Pt addition to FeCoNi-based alloy can induce L1₀ chemical ordering
L1₀ ordering reduces crystal symmetry and enhances magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy significantly increases coercivity
The coercivity increase can exceed an order of magnitude relative to the fcc state
The approach is applicable to high-entropy alloy thin films on Si/SiO₂ with RTA
